message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Step | What Happens | Key Points | |------|--------------|------------| | **1. Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck (108 cards).
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. | • If the first card is an action card, its effect applies to the first player. | | **2. Turn Order** | • Players take turns clockwise (or counterclockwise if a reverse card is played). | • Each turn consists of either playing a card or drawing one. | | **3. Playing a Card** | • On your turn, you may play one card from your hand that matches the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top discard card.
• You may also play a Wild card (any color) or a Wild Draw Four (any color, forces next player to draw four). | • If you play a Wild or Wild Draw Four, you must declare the new color. | | **4. Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Same as Wild, but next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | • A Wild Draw Four can only be played if you have no playable card of the current color. | | **5. Drawing a Card** | • If you cannot play any card, you must draw one from the draw pile.
• If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | • If the draw pile runs out, reshuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile. | | **6. Going Out** | • When you play your last card, shout “Uno!” if you have one card left.
• If you forget, the next player can call “Uno” and you must draw two penalty cards. | • The round ends when a player has no cards left. | | **7. Scoring** | • After a round, the winner scores points based on the cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points.
• First to reach 500 points wins the game. | • Scores are tallied after each round; play continues until someone reaches 500. | **Quick Tips** - Keep track of the current color and number to anticipate opponents’ moves. - Use Wild Draw Four strategically—only when you’re sure you have no matching color. - Remember to say “Uno” when you’re down to one card! Enjoy your game!
